name: background-controller
title: Background Controller
description: Site-wide animated background system — a provider + segmented switcher driving CSS gradient, JS canvas, and pure-CSS pattern backdrops (dots, grid, mesh, starfield, synthwave/moonrise/clouds/dune horizons with a placeable sun or moon, a fogbound coastal redwood forest, an alpine range at sunrise, rolling meadow hills, a liner, clipper, freighter or cruise ship crossing the sea, dancing aurora borealis under a moon, Pac-Man chase, and more) that recolor with the live glass tint and accent. Exposes density, speed, accent, and a themed "none" base-color.
